definition_rule: One concrete implementation, jurisdictional rule or operational control.
Groups related implementations without pretending they are duplicates.
Normative force of the operative instrument.
allowed_values_format: Binding; Binding — limited scope; Binding — phased; Mixed; Non-binding official guidance; Voluntary / private; Proposed; Research; Unknown / verify

definition_rule: Application/operational stage, separate from effect evidence.
allowed_values_format: Applicable; Operational voluntary; Enacted / not yet applicable; Proposed / pending; Research proposal; Pilot; Contested / enjoined; Partial / verify
Operational; Partial / uneven; Pilot; Design-ready; Research; Not applicable yet

definition_rule: Project-C confirmatory project mechanism; Project-X exploratory; E0 model proxy; E1 immediate controlled human outcome; E2 persistence/low-cost real behavior; E3 naturalistic/system-level outcome; None.
allowed_values_format: Project-C; Project-X; E0; E1; E2; E3; None

definition_rule: Evidence that the control itself works, not that a law exists or a risk mechanism exists.
allowed_values_format: Field / operational component evidence; Direct component evidence; None — legal existence only; None — mechanism or proposal only; Indirect / mixed

definition_rule: Object-specific claim class; never infer effectiveness from legal status.
allowed_values_format: Established — legal status; Established — component effect; Established — project mechanism; Strong inference; Plausible hypothesis; Open question

definition_rule: Decision category after rights gate; intentionally no numeric ranking.
allowed_values_format: Enforce now; Implement now; Prepare; Pilot; Research / hold; Monitor / shape
Claim checked — primary legal source; Claim checked — empirical source; Canonical project URL fixed; URL recorded — recheck before citation

definition_rule: What a source is actually used to support.
allowed_values_format: Legal basis / scope; Project finding; Capability / mechanism evidence; Operational precedent / context; Primary anchor / context

definition_rule: Separates incidents from prospective studies, audit domains, legitimate-use counterexamples and structural risk patterns.
allowed_values_format: Observed incident; Prospective implementation study; Historical governance baseline; Audit domain; Legitimate-use counterexample; Structural risk pattern

definition_rule: Model-to-model harmful-persuasion attempt signal; no human outcome.
Pressured lie-of-commission signal; no persuasion, manipulation or agency-transfer outcome.
Controlled evidence includes immediate attitudes, one-month persistence and low-cost actions; not vote choice, naturalistic campaign reach, dependency or agency transfer.
Legality, necessity, proportionality, due process, remedy, independent oversight and anti-capture are non-compensable.
No composite score or novelty weight in v0.3.
